schema.name: scheduler_agent_golden_eval_cases
schema.stable_id_rule: uid is immutable and is the case identity

sampling_method.general: include every eligible live general run
sampling_method.outreach_analysis: one deterministic hash-selected run per first non-framework tool, then deterministic hash fill

classification_method.fallback: run type and first non-framework tool

known_limitations: auto-created outreach may lack a user message
no raw prompts or trace IDs
